description: Official sources are coming soon for every RMF step, while they are revised. Until a step has entries, its section shows one Coming soon card with no publisher, version, date or link. When sources return, add an entry only when an official publisher posts the document publicly without sign-in, and link to the publisher's copy. The Secure By Design training samples are available now.

groups.title: Prepare
groups.note: Name the people who run the system's security program, in writing.

groups.title: Categorize
groups.note: Decide the system's confidentiality, integrity and availability impact and whether it is a national security system.

groups.title: Select
groups.note: Start from the control baseline, then tailor it with the overlays that fit the system. These are the first columns of the SCTM.

groups.title: Implement
groups.note: Record how each selected control is implemented, with the inventory and configuration management the SSP relies on. The SSP is drafted when the controls are selected and completed here.

groups.title: Assess
groups.note: Record the test results, turn findings into risk the authorizing official can weigh, and plan the fixes.

groups.title: Authorize
groups.note: Assemble the authorization package, take it through review, and record the Authorizing Official’s decision and its termination date.

groups.title: Monitor
groups.note: Keep the authorization current: watch the controls, review changes and report on schedule.

samples.title: SCTM workbook (NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5)
samples.basis: JSIG Tasks 2-2 and 3-2; NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Release 5.2.0, SP 800-53A and SP 800-53B (NIST OSCAL data)
samples.note: All 1,014 Rev. 5 controls and enhancements with NIST's baseline marks and SP 800-53A methods, plus columns to record the CNSSI 1253 baseline, overlays, tailoring rationale, implementation and assessment result. A summary sheet counts status and results as you fill it in.

samples.title: POA&M workbook
samples.basis: JSIG Task 5-1; CDSE POA&M Job Aid field names; NIST SP 800-30 risk scale
samples.note: Standard POA&M columns, one row per milestone, with the JSIG minimum (tasks, resources, milestones with percentage complete, scheduled dates) and a summary sheet.

samples.title: ISSM, ISSO and ISSE appointment letters
samples.basis: JSIG sections 1.5.13 to 1.5.15; DCSA ISSM appointment letter layout
samples.note: Three memoranda, one page each, with the duties the JSIG assigns each role, who appoints them, and an acknowledgment block.

samples.title: Hardware and software lists
samples.note: A hardware list with the JSIG CM-8 minimum fields and an approved software list (deny-all, permit-by-exception), each with CCB approval and integrity-check columns.

samples.title: Continuous monitoring strategy
samples.basis: JSIG RMF Step 6 and CA-7; NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 CA-7; NIST SP 800-137
samples.note: Roles, metrics, monitoring and assessment frequencies, analysis, reporting and change handling, organized by CA-7 a to g, with fill-in tables.

samples.title: Configuration management plan
samples.basis: JSIG CM-2, CM-3, CM-4, CM-7, CM-8 and CM-9; NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 CM-9; NIST SP 800-128
samples.note: Roles, configuration items, baselines, the CCB and the JSIG's site rules, a six-step change process with a worked change request, compliance monitoring and plan approval.
